justifications.structure: Clean layering: model/solver/engine/report are shared by the CLI, the server (+store, sweep) and an Elm-style UI (state/ui/canvas/table/bench) with separate desktop and web entry points. engine.solve (engine.zig:231-545) is a 315-line monolith.
justifications.naming: The solver is easy to follow, with SPEC-section doc comments and inline formulas (solver.zig:220-275). Names are terse elsewhere (nn, nm, ef, st, pnode, sh), and there is some leftover code (solver.zig:49,59; cli.zig:109; engine.zig:421 duplicates :312).
justifications.errors: Typed Outcome{ok,err} keeps model errors apart from Zig errors. CLI exits 2/1, the server returns 422/400/500, the UI shows code: detail (state.zig:169, ui.zig:115). Gaps: empty node or member lists crash, a bad request body closes the socket with no reply, parse errors lose their location.
justifications.boundary: FFI is kept in store.zig (SQLite), platform.zig (kernel32) and web/main.zig (wasm exports). The engine has no raw pointers. Store has a mutex, sweep uses atomics with an arena per variant. Weak points: unchecked null from sqlite3_column_text (store.zig:42), ignored bind return codes, mutable globals, sweep error arena relies on the swap guard.
justifications.tests: 11 tests: F01, F13, the gen 10x10 profile, F23-F25, a skyline solve, an RCM permutation check, gen sizes, 3 headless UI tests. No tests for the other error codes, UDL, stations, residual, number formatting, RCM order, or server/sweep/report/cli.
justifications.change_resilience: A new load type touches 2 files (model.zig, engine.zig). Results, report, server and UI are unchanged, but the UDL is hard-coded in 6 places inside engine.solve, including the station formulas (engine.zig:500).

load_type_touch_points: src/model.zig:LoadCase (new load struct + array field, model.zig:36-43)
src/engine.zig:solve (per-case load accumulation + equivalent nodal loads into rhs, engine.zig:440-465)
src/engine.zig:fixedEnd / memberFixedEnd (new fixed-end vector, condensed for releases, engine.zig:126-133,189-192)
src/engine.zig:solve (end-force recovery f = k*u + f_fixed, engine.zig:486)
src/engine.zig:solve (equilibrium load resultant and moment, engine.zig:504-514)
generated_excluded: dist/ (index.html, app.js, app.js.map, web.wasm, .zunk_cache): generated by zunk/Teak linkWebWgpu
zig-pkg/: vendored package sources (teak, zunk, rich_zig, sqlite amalgamation, wgpu-native)
frame2d-models.db, frame2d-models.db-shm, frame2d-models.db-wal: runtime SQLite store
notable: Strength: the engine is pure and allocator-parameterised and every front end shares it; the CLI wraps it with a counting allocator for the SPEC 5.2 alloc stats (cli.zig:80-92).
Strength: static condensation is implemented once for stiffness and fixed-end forces (condenseK/condenseF, engine.zig:101-123), so released end moments come out exactly 0.
Strength: RCM follows SPEC 4.4 step for step (solver.zig:103-181); skyline LDL^T with SIMD dot; BENCH-EDIT:leaf tolerance at solver.zig:225; unstable reports node id + component (engine.zig:419-425).
Strength: Elm-style UI split (state.zig update vs ui.zig view) with headless tests via teak.CmdBuffer.

Risk: engine.solve frees its non-result allocations by hand; early fail() returns leak unless the caller passes an arena (not documented). cli.zig:freeResults (cli.zig:142-155) mirrors the Results layout by hand.
Risk: one detached 8 MB-stack thread per connection with no limit (server.zig:43-47), plus cpu_count threads per /sweep (sweep.zig:86-96).
Risk: lag_max hard-coded to 0 (bench.zig:106) and no per-frame solve_ms/lag_frames log, only the aggregate BENCH line.

Defect [High]: engine.zig:242 for (1..nn) and engine.zig:251 for (1..nm) are reversed ranges when there are no nodes or members: a panic in safe builds, undefined behaviour in the ReleaseFast server/CLI (length underflow, out-of-bounds reads). A model with no members, or {}, can crash the whole server instead of returning 422.
Defect [Medium]: the equilibrium residual uses only the force components; the moment sum load_sum[2] is computed and then dropped (engine.zig:531), so moment equilibrium is never verified (SPEC 4.5).

Defect [Low]: save_bytes is allocated in model_arena (state.zig:261-264), which generate resets (state.zig:116) and loadJson frees (state.zig:129); an in-flight download effect can be left pointing at freed memory, and each Save grows the arena.
Defect [Low]: store.zig:42 @ptrCast of sqlite3_column_text is not null-checked (undefined behaviour in ReleaseFast on SQLite OOM); sqlite3_bind_text return codes are ignored (store.zig:28-29,40).

Defect [Low]: server.zig:90 maps a body read failure to BadRequest and handleConn (server.zig:66) closes the socket with no HTTP response; a 413 decided from Content-Length leaves the body unread on a keep-alive connection (server.zig:88).
Defect [Low]: sweep returns roof_drift_W = 0 silently when there is no case W (sweep.zig:59-63); sections are copied twice (model.clone + sweep.zig:45).
Defect [Low]: FRAME2D_ADDR is split on the last ':' without stripping brackets, so [::1]:8080 fails to parse (server.zig:29-31).
Defect [Low]: the member table sort is not re-applied after a re-solve, so during a drag the displayed order no longer matches the new values (state.zig:164 only resets the row count).
